We provide complimentary exchange shipping in cases of:
• Defective or damaged products
• Printing or manufacturing issues
To request an exchange, contact us via:
• Email: support@deencommerce.com
Please ensure the item is:
• In its original condition
• Returned with tags and packaging intact
For eligible requests, our team will arrange a pickup from your location and process the exchange as quickly as possible.
If an exchange is not possible, you may request a return instead. Once the item is received and inspected, refunds are processed within 1 business day to your original payment method.
We stand behind the quality of our products. In select situations, we may offer a replacement or refund without requiring the item to be returned because your trust means everything to us.
